proposals.explanation: CredentialHandler returns API keys directly, otherwise reuses cached tokens until five minutes before expiry and obtains a replacement using the configured/default scope.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: The separate src/auth helper has no generated header and implements a stateful credential lifecycle for the custom websocket session layer, consistent with the guideline's handwritten-module layout.

proposals.explanation: Null token results become VoiceLiveAuthenticationError; other acquisition exceptions are wrapped with an authentication failure code and cause while existing authentication errors are preserved.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: The src/auth module without a generation marker implements explicit credential error normalization around getToken.

proposals.explanation: The credential helper converts HTTP(S) endpoints to WS(S), sets the realtime path/version, selects model or agent query parameters, adds an API-key query parameter for key credentials, and supplies handshake headers.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: The standalone auth helper explicitly constructs websocket URLs and headers outside ordinary generated operation/model files.

proposals.explanation: SessionTarget models mutually exclusive model/agent session creation, with an agent configuration interface and exported guards identifying each target.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: The definitions live in src/client/types.ts separately from the imported service models and carry no generated header, matching a custom client configuration module.

proposals.explanation: createSession merges client/default/per-call options and accepts a model string, an exclusive model/agent target or a full RequestSession, constructing VoiceLiveSession accordingly and retaining the full configuration.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: The public src/client factory without generated markers composes a websocket session class rather than emitting a standard REST operation.

proposals.explanation: startSession creates a session, installs provided handlers before connecting, then sends a full RequestSession configuration after connection when that overload was used.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: This custom client method explicitly orchestrates the websocket session lifecycle without generated markers.

proposals.explanation: The client and session constructors normalize endpoints by adding https:// when no HTTP(S) prefix is present and removing a trailing slash.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: The normalization bodies are visible in the separate custom src/client modules without generated headers.

proposals.explanation: VoiceLiveSession assembles the credential handler, parser, subscription manager and connection manager, obtains handshake data, forwards connection abort/timeout, and clears connection/session/turn state on disconnect or disposal.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: The src/client session module explicitly composes protocol and websocket helpers and holds connection state outside service model definitions, with no generated marker.

proposals.explanation: updateSession and addConversationItem validate connection state, build typed protocol events with generated event ids and send them through the session.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: The custom src/client session layer constructs events using separately imported service model types.

proposals.explanation: sendAudio converts ArrayBuffer/Uint8Array to base64 and sends a turn-append event when a turn id is supplied or a buffer-append event otherwise.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: The custom session method manually constructs protocol event variants in a non-generated src/client module.

proposals.explanation: startAudioTurn generates or accepts a turn id and stores it; endAudioTurn uses an explicit or active id, rejects missing state, sends the end event and clears a matching active id.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: The custom session layer maintains local turn state around separately imported wire event types.

proposals.explanation: Incoming messages are parsed, server SessionCreated events update the session id, and connection/server events are asynchronously forwarded to subscriptions with endpoint/model/agent context; server dispatch requires a session id.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: The session module explicitly layers subscription and local-session behavior over its protocol parser, without a generated header.

proposals.explanation: A connected-to-disconnected transition or connection error notifies handlers and permanently marks the session disposed, clears state, and causes later use to throw SESSION_DEAD.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: Explicit connection-state handlers and local guards in the non-generated session module implement this terminal lifecycle.

proposals.explanation: The session initializes a telemetry tracker with endpoint/model/agent context, records connection success/errors, traces sent/received events and closes tracing on disconnect or terminal failure.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: These explicit instrumentation calls appear throughout the custom session wrapper, outside ordinary wire models.
